items_flat.title_en: SpaceXAI launches Grok 4.7 for coding and knowledge work
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceXAI 推出 Grok 4.7：主打編程與知識工作
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced Grok 4.7 on September 21, calling it its most capable model for coding and knowledge work. The lab says it uses a new, larger base than Grok 4.6, with a longer RL run on multi-hour tasks, stronger self-checking and context management, and native Grok Bot harness understanding. It is available today in Cursor, Grok Build, the Grok API, third-party coding harnesses, and model routers, at the same list price as Grok 4.6: $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens, plus a faster variant at twice the output speed and twice the price.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 於 9 月 21 日宣布推出 Grok 4.7，定位為其目前最強的編程與知識工作模型。官方表示它採用比 Grok 4.6 更大的新基底，並以更長的強化學習訓練多小時任務，強化自我核對與長上下文管理，並原生理解 Grok Bot harness。即日起可在 Cursor、Grok Build、Grok API、第三方編程 harness 與模型路由使用，標價與 4.6 相同：每百萬 input token $2、output $6；另有輸出速度加倍、價格加倍的 fast 變體。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a same-price capability step, not a new pricing war: SpaceXAI is competing on long-horizon coding and office work while keeping 4.6 economics. Independent third-party leaderboards and multimodal gaps flagged earlier by Musk remain the main uncertainties until external evals catch up.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是「同價升級」而非新一輪降價戰：SpaceXAI 用長時程編程與辦公任務表現來競爭，同時維持 4.6 的單位價格。獨立第三方排行與先前 Musk 承認的多模態落差，在外部評測跟上前仍是主要不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.7 is our most capable model for coding and knowledge work. It works longer on difficult tasks, checks its own work more carefully, and comes with our best-calibrated safeguards to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.7 是我們目前最強的編程與知識工作模型。它能在困難任務上工作更久、更仔細檢查自己的成果，並配備我們迄今校準最好的安全機制。

brief_en: SpaceXAI officially launched Grok 4.7, a larger-base coding and knowledge-work model at Grok 4.6 prices ($2/$6 per 1M tokens), live in Cursor, Grok Build, and the Grok API. Other tracked labs posted no new official model or product announcements in the window.
brief_zh: SpaceXAI 正式推出 Grok 4.7：更大基底的編程與知識工作模型，價格與 4.6 相同（每百萬 token $2/$6），已上線 Cursor、Grok Build 與 Grok API。其他追蹤實驗室在窗口內無新官方模型或產品公告。
